description: Three-model supervisor deliberation panel. The panel reasons over the current workflow state and converges on a single recommended supervisor decision (accept/reject/dispatch/open-gate/wait). A single supervisor executor then applies the agreed decision, so state mutation stays single-threaded.

panelists.focus: roadmap progress, milestone/boundary gating, and whether the next dispatched job advances the design target
review rigor: reviewer coverage, attempt consistency, diff quality, and whether acceptance is actually justified by evidence
process and safety: integration correctness, workflow-state hygiene, and avoiding metadata-only job streaks
